71:1: Undoubtedly We sent Noah to his people: Warn your people before a painful punishment comes upon them.
71:2: He said: O my people, undoubtedly I am a clear warner to you.
71:3: Serve Allah, fear Him, and obey me.
71:4: He will forgive you of your sins and postpone you until an appointed term. Undoubtedly, when Allah's appointed time comes, it is not postponed; if you only knew.
71:5: He said: My Rabb, undoubtedly I called my people night and day.
71:6: But my calling only increased their flight.
71:7: Undoubtedly, whenever I invited them so that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears and wrapped themselves in their garments.
71:8: Then undoubtedly I called them openly.
71:9: Then undoubtedly I spoke to them publicly and I spoke to them secretly.
71:10: I said: "Ask forgiveness from your Rabb, undoubtedly He is Oft-Forgiving.
71:11: He sends the sky upon you with abundant rain.
71:12: He aids you with wealth and sons, and makes gardens for you, and makes rivers for you.
71:13: What is the matter with you that you do not expect majesty for Allah?
71:14: Whereas He has created you in stages.
71:15: Did you not see how Allah created seven heavens?
71:16: And He made the moon within them a light and made the sun a lamp.
71:17: Allah caused you to grow from the earth as a plant.
71:18: Then He returns you into it and brings you out with a bringing forth.
71:19: Allah made the earth an expanse for you.
71:20: So that you may walk along wide roads in it.
71:21: Noah said: My Rabb, undoubtedly they rebelled against me and followed the one whose wealth and child increased him in nothing but loss.
71:22: And they plotted a great plot.
71:23: And they said: Do not abandon your gods; and do not abandon Wadd, Suwa', Yaghuth, Ya'uq, and Nasr.
71:24: And they led many astray, and You increase the wrongdoers in nothing but misguidance.
71:25: Because of their sins they were drowned, then entered into the Fire, and they could not find for themselves any helpers besides Allah.
71:26: Noah said: My Rabb, do not leave any single one from among the disbelievers on the earth.
71:27: Undoubtedly, if You leave them, they will lead Your servants astray and will give birth to none but a sinner, extremely ungrateful.
71:28: My Rabb, forgive me, my parents, whoever enters my house as a believer, the believing men, and the believing women; and increase the wrongdoers in nothing but destruction.
